title: Core Awakening
tagline: Rebuild your identity from the wreckage of fallen Titans.
pitch: As the last remnant of a Titan AI, players navigate a compact modular mech to tactically dismantle enemies and recover valuable components. Each battle is a strategic puzzle where every decision impacts your survival and power.
coreLoop: Players read enemy attack intents, dodge or intercept, target subsystems, and dismantle foes for salvage. Every victory brings a meaningful choice to install, secure, or dismantle components.

mechanics.name: Read and Evade
mechanics.description: Players interpret clear enemy telegraphs to dodge or interrupt attacks, maintaining control of the flow of battle.

mechanics.name: Subsystem Targeting
mechanics.description: Combat allows targeting of specific enemy subsystems to destroy or preserve them for salvage.

mechanics.name: Three-Way Decision Making
mechanics.description: After defeating an enemy, players must choose between installing, securing, or dismantling a salvaged component, each with distinct immediate effects.

controls.keyboard: WASD for movement, mouse for aiming and targeting

artDirection.backgroundFx: large silhouettes of machinery add depth and context

audioDirection.musicMood: tense and atmospheric with mechanical undertones

difficulty.start: simple enemy attack patterns make initial encounters manageable
difficulty.progression: enemy attacks become more complex, requiring sharper reflexes and tactical decisions
difficulty.peak: the challenge culminates in a tense decision-making moment after a tough battle

winLose.win: successfully extract salvaged components after a battle
winLose.lose: defeated by the enemy before making a salvage decision

juice.flash: when a subsystem is destroyed or preserved

scopeNotes: Do not implement procedural dungeons, economy/shop systems, multiple enemy types, bosses, inventory management, upgrades between runs, narrative scenes beyond one line of flavor text, or save systems.

scoreEvents: score increases when an enemy is defeated and when components are salvaged
